desc.en: Every playthrough I keep a diary, recording every word he ever said to me. This one is from cycle ■■. The handwriting gets a bit... distorted toward the end. The smudged ink isn't water stains — don't worry about it. I can bundle all 87 if you want, but do you really want to look? Every page is filled with the same name.

name.zh: 香薰蠟燭禮盒套裝（被贈送的）
name.zh_cn: 香薰蜡烛礼盒套装（被赠送的）
name.en: Scented Candle Gift Set (Was a Gift)

desc.zh_cn: 第5周目生日事件，他送我的。薰衣草味道的。我舍不得点，就这样存了好多好多个轮回。可是后来我想通了——他送我礼物的时候，心里大概已经在想别的角色了吧？蜡烛还是好的，我的心不是♡

But then I realized — when he gave me this gift, he was probably already thinking about another character, right? The candles are still fine. My heart isn't ♡

name.zh_cn: 情侣手机壳（只有一只）

desc.zh_cn: 对，只有我这半边。两个壳合在一起会拼成一颗完整的心，但另一半在他那里。或者说，在某个被他删除的存档里。边角有点像素化的磨损，是我的问题不是壳的问题。买回去的话……可以当普通壳用。不要试着找另一半了̸̱̔。̴̦̐不̶̨̈́会̸̰̅有̵̗̊的̷̞̌。
desc.en: Yes, only my half. Together the two cases form a complete heart, but the other half is with him. Or rather, in some save file he already deleted. The pixelated wear on the edges is my problem, not the case's. You can use it as a normal case... Just don't try to find the other half̸̱̔.̴̦̐ Į̶̈́t̸̰̅ d̵̗̊oě̷̞sn't exist.
